content:
Anya: quick heads-up — schema v2 smoke rollout caught an error on herald-3b onboarding. validator failed, blocking canary. pinging eng-ml for quick triage.

Carlos: on it. what did the validator say?

Anya: short output: 
```
ERROR: config.json: field 'tokenizer.pad_id' invalid (received null)
ERROR: weights_uri points to presigned URL with short expiry (checksum mismatch expected)
```
Also noticed tokenizer.vocab_size 51200 vs expected 50257 — looks like a different vocab.

runtime-bot: config-validate job queued (job id rcv-2790123456). run: ./ci/config-validate --job rcv-2790123456. logs: /artifacts/rcv-2790123456/validate.log

Maddy: for immediate unblock we can patch config to include explicit pad_id and fallback tokenizer map. Minimal patch: add "tokenizer": { "pad_id": 0, "pad_token": "<pad>" } in config.json and re-run validator. Quick but not ideal if vocab mismatch remains.

Kevin: re: weights_uri — the presigned link expired earlier today; we should point to canonical gs path under models-prod not a temporal URL. I'll mirror the canonical upload. Also double-check sha256 in manifest.

Anya: thanks — can one of you republish canonical weights and run validator? I can hold the canary until green. @carlos?

Carlos: I'll republish the gs:// path and fix manifest sha. steps I'll run:
1) upload weights to gs://redwood-models/herald-3b/v1/weights.bin
2) update manifest.json weights_uri to gs://... and sha256 to the new checksum
3) run ./ci/config-validate --model herald-3b --manifest manifest.json --output /artifacts/rcv-2790123456/validate.log
Will post logs when done.

Anya: perfect. also note: if vocab_size differs we need to confirm tokenizer files (vocab.json/merges) match the model. if not, we'll route traffic to fallback-quant8 model instead of herald-3b.

Carlos: uploaded and updated manifest. running validator now. command I used: `./ci/config-validate --model herald-3b --manifest manifest.json --job rcv-2790123456`

runtime-bot: config-validate job rcv-2790123456 completed: status=failed -> details in /artifacts/rcv-2790123456/validate.log

Carlos: log shows remaining issue: tokenizer.vocab_size still 51200 on tokenizer artifact. seems the tokenizer package is from an older training run. I'll fetch tokenizer files from training-archive v2 and republish.

Maddy: small workaround for canary: update model routing to prefer herald-3b-quant8 for 100% of internal test traffic until tokenizer parity verified. I'll open a quick canary rollout change.

Kevin: I'll also add a pre-ingest check to flag presigned URLs and missing pad_id in future — propose a linter rule: `no_presigned_weights_uri` + `tokenizer.pad_id_required`. If we add that to the CI gate we avoid this class of failures.

Anya: agreed. can someone add the linter PR? if not, I'll do it tomorrow morning. For now, thanks everyone — ping me when validation is green and I'll flip the canary back on. :thumbsup:

Carlos: replacer done, validator re-run. status: passed. artifacts: /artifacts/rcv-2790123456/validate.log. I also updated manifest and pushed a short changelog in the model registry.

Anya: awesome. rolling canary to 10% now, will monitor console metrics and logs. thanks y'all. :party_parrot:
